G=load(); print(sorted(G))

    # Based on analysis of the pattern
    # Each output cell maps to specific input positions
    
    out = [[0]*3 for _ in range(3)]
    
    # Top row from top corners and inner-top positions
    out[0][0] = in_grid[0][0]      # TL corner
    out[0][1] = in_grid[1][1]      # Inner-top-right diagonal
    out[0][2] = in_grid[0][4]      # TR corner

    out[1][0] = in_grid[3][1]      # Left edge (from bottom-left quadrant)
